entries.notes: Large browser regression monolith; bond drawing plus homogeneous, bond/arrow mixed-object, and nested mixed-group clipboard paths are migrated into formal scenarios. Existing gate remains active.

Production scenarios now cover real blank-document text creation, multiline entry, multi-object public property editing, exact existing-text replacement, undo/redo, cancelled replacement, line-spacing validation/cancel/history, native save, and exact CCJS persistence. Selection-range formatting, IME/composition, endpoint labels, canceling new-object creation, and the remaining property matrix stay active in the legacy gate.

The single tool and ten-variant matrix have current production evidence; the matrix independently kills wrong order, line-pattern, bold-weight, wedge-kind, and initial wide-end mutants. The double-placement cell has independent physical evidence for Left, Right, Center, regenerated selected state, and exact final persistence. Solid/Hashed/Hollow wedge endpoint reversal, the Single-tool single-to-double cycle, the direct-draw Dashed-solid double placement/line-side cycle, and the Dashed and Bold style cycles now have independent physical evidence. The registered Triple/Hash/Wavy center-replacement cell next proves that three existing dashed doubles retain identity while clearing stale double metadata and persisting exact replacement semantics. Attachment, colors, labels, grouped/locked behavior, other formats, and large documents remain explicit.

The reaction history/value cells cover every public participation value, checked state, annotation branch, history, and persistence. The query-order matrix covers None, S/D, S/A, D/A and exact ordered persistence. The topology matrix covers Unspecified, Ring, Chain, Ring or Chain, checked states, annotation replacement/clear, and exact persistence. The absolute-stereo matrix covers Unspecified, None, E, and Z under explicit Show Stereo. The registered visibility matrix independently traverses Inherit Document Setting, Show, and Hide for Show Query, Show Reaction, and Show Stereo, verifies checked states and annotation branches, and persists exact false/false/true overrides. Mixed selections, imported document defaults, formats, and scale remain explicit.

Production evidence uses real Save As/Open toolbar actions, native Windows dialogs, guarded mouse/keyboard/text input, dirty-tab close with explicit Don't Save, guest-to-host SHA-256 transfer, independent CLI chemical validation, disk reopen, and continued editing. Other formats, multi-tab interactions, overwrite/error paths, autosave/recovery, and large documents remain.

Production evidence covers solid arrows created through real mouse input and then edited into a persisted mirrored-curved variant, plus mixed selection, region/additive selection, nested groups, locked partial deletion, same-/cross-type locked transforms, locked groups, uniform history, and locked mixed-property workflows; direct drawing presets for every remaining variant still require their own cells.

Production evidence uses public nested context menus for uniform and locked/editable arrow pairs. It covers line style, both endpoint directions, mirrored-curved variant, large head size, 120-degree curve, no-go hash, red color, field-preserving patches, independent history, and exact saved-CCJS properties. Other variants and every size/curve/no-go/color value, grouped targets, import/export formats, and large documents remain explicit.

Production evidence starts from blank documents, opens the public Text tool, enters independent single-line and multiline strings through guarded real Windows input, commits them, and verifies exact saved CCJS content. Endpoint labels, selection ranges, IME/composition, canceling new-object creation, and large documents remain.

Production evidence reopens a GUI-created bold text object, proves its exact editor content, replaces the selected content through guarded keyboard/text input, commits it, observes exact undo and redo transitions, reopens it again, cancels a second replacement with Escape, and verifies the surviving styled content on disk. Selection ranges, partial replacement, multiline existing text, IME/composition, endpoint labels, grouped/locked text, and large documents remain.

Production evidence batch-edits two GUI-created text objects through public context menus for bold, Times New Roman, italic, underline, outline, shadow, superscript-to-subscript transition, right alignment, 24 pt size, and green color, independently covers line-spacing validation, and proves bold survives existing-text replacement, undo/redo, cancel, and filesystem persistence. Remaining values, mixed values, locked/grouped text, formula mode, and further invalid boundaries remain.

Production evidence draws circle, ellipse, rounded rectangle, and rectangle objects through guarded real mouse input with solid, dashed, shaded, and filled toolbar styles, then batch-applies Shadowed through the public context menu, proves undo/redo, and verifies exact saved CCJS kinds and style fields. Faded, colors, locked/grouped shapes, transforms, clipboard, other formats, and large documents remain.

Production evidence creates all eight public charge/electron symbol kinds through guarded real pointer input, batch-applies Green through the public context menu, proves black/green undo and redo, and independently verifies exact kind plus matching payload/style color persistence. Positive, negative, radical-cation, radical-anion, and single-electron attachment cells now have current passing evidence; the newly registered branch targets lone-pair attachment to terminal nitrogen with exact neutral non-radical node, atom/link, and zero chemistry-delta persistence. Label-glyph attachment variants, orbit dragging, the other two chemical attachment kinds, locked/grouped symbols, transforms, clipboard, import/export, and large documents remain.

Production evidence draws all three public paired bracket kinds, exposes Bracket Type for bracket-group roots, batch-applies kind and color to all six visible sides, proves color undo/redo, and independently verifies exact CCJS 0.2 hierarchy.children pair membership plus side properties. Labels, repeat-count links, molecule containment, resizing, locking, clipboard, import/export, and large documents remain.

The registered production scenario inserts a 2 by 2 native table through the public modal, expands it to 3 by 3 from a real cell context menu, edits horizontal and vertical alignment, applies a dashed box border with explicit width, proves undo/redo through reopened dialogs, and independently validates unique cells, monotonic guides, exact structure, and CCJS persistence. Invalid insert bounds, every row/column operation and position, cell contents, clear/size-to-fit, all alignments, none/custom borders, edge combinations, color, locking, transforms, clipboard, import/export, multiple tables, and large documents remain explicit.

Production evidence draws all seven public orbital templates through guarded real mouse input, batch-retargets mixed ellipse and axis geometry to dz2, batch-edits style and phase through public orbital menus, proves phase undo/redo, and independently validates exact saved payload, nonzero axis geometry, equal final axis length/bounding size/angle, and style fields. The intentionally mixed intermediate phase is exercised through the public menu, but a saved pre-normalization checkpoint for the seven distinct templates remains explicit. Colors, all individual style/phase combinations, attachments, transforms, locking, grouping, clipboard, import/export, multiple orbitals at scale, and large documents remain explicit.

Production evidence draws native TLC and gel plates, batch-colors frames plus every internal spot/band, moves a TLC Rf mark and gel band value through guarded drags, proves undo/redo, and independently validates exact saved lanes, marks, display flags, and colors. Lane editing, mark creation/deletion and size/shape/labels, gel axes/ranges/units, transforms, lock/group/clipboard, import/export, multiple plates at scale, and large documents remain explicit.

Production evidence covers homogeneous molecule/bond objects, mixed molecule/bond/arrow selection, copied nested roots, locked/unlocked pairs, a locked group mixed with an editable root, repeated two-arrow uniform/mixed property selection, text, shape, and standalone symbol targets; the registered bracket cell adds three paired bracket-group roots and six visible sides across history and persistence. Remaining object types and selection modes are still required.

Production evidence covers mixed molecule/arrow select-all, region and Shift-additive cardinalities, clipboard, history, grouping, nesting, batch ungroup, and locked/editable partial movement; additional object types and partial applicability remain.

Production evidence covers Ctrl+G and Ctrl+Shift+G for mixed groups, two nested roots, selection preservation, and grouped-arrow transform behavior before and after Lock; context-menu grouping, other object classes, hidden members, and persistence remain.

Production evidence covers depth-two molecule/arrow hierarchy creation, Windows clipboard duplication, structural DOM nesting, batch outer ungroup, and retained inner groups; deeper nesting, cross-group movement, transforms, save/reopen, and import/export remain.
Production evidence covers same-document homogeneous, mixed, and nested duplication plus mixed-object copy into a newly created document tab; cross-surface cells remain.

Production evidence locks GUI-created arrows, a molecule, and a group through the public context menu, observes and applies Unlock, and preserves effective lock through mixed deletion, movement, line-style, and endpoint property edits. Text objects, persistence, grouped property edits, and other mutation commands remain.

Production evidence covers real pointer movement of locked/editable arrow and molecule/arrow pairs plus a locked group ancestor, exact semantic world-coordinate stationary/moved checks, one-step undo/redo, public Unlock, and subsequent movement of all editable members. Rotation, resize, alignment/distribution, text, and large documents remain.

Production evidence creates a two-child group, locks the parent through its public context menu, proves both descendants remain stationary while an editable root moves across drag/undo/redo, then unlocks the parent and proves all three objects move. Nested locked ancestors, partial descendant selection, deletion, properties, save/reopen, and import/export remain.

Production evidence covers atomic homogeneous and mixed bond/arrow deletion, zero/one/two/many region and Shift-additive selection, plus locked/unlocked partial applicability with one-step undo/redo; grouped, nested, hidden, overlapping, and large-document deletion cells remain.

Production evidence now covers empty, single, heterogeneous pair, and Shift-additive many-object region selection with deletion and history transitions; further object types, hidden/locked objects, cross-group movement, and partial viewport coverage remain.
Production evidence covers mixed-object copy from one in-app document tab into a newly created blank tab; browser/desktop, Office, paste-special, and independently opened document boundaries remain.

Production evidence now covers a locked/unlocked arrow pair, real context-menu locking, partial deletion, and one-step undo/redo. Grouped/nested, hidden, overlapping, other object classes, locked ancestors, and large-document production cells remain.

Physical production scenarios use guarded real Windows input plus bounded CDP observations to verify focus ownership, focus-ring paint, hover paint, disabled opacity/cursor, text selection bounds after a font metric change, bond selection minimum screen size, resize-handle screen size, canvas hover/focus, actual viewport, and 150 percent device scaling. The minimum interactive box is intentionally bond-specific rather than a universal tight-bounds rule. Keyboard-only focus-visible traversal, every cursor/tool state, dark theme, 100/125/175/200 percent scaling, window resizing, multi-monitor transitions, and visual collision/contrast cells remain explicit.

The passing production cells persist exact public-palette semantics for all 118 periodic values. The dedicated matrices cover 116 values including explicit standalone Carbon, while existing bonded attachment cells independently cover Nitrogen and Oxygen. Isotope/charge/radical/valence properties, label editing, attachment variants, history, formats, and scale remain explicit.

Passing production evidence traverses Natural, every public isotope preset 2/3/13/14/15/18, the custom integer dialog, clearing, regenerated checked state, and exact 13C persistence. Multi-atom/mixed values, invalid/cancel input, import/export, history, and scale remain explicit.

Passing production evidence traverses Unspecified, Any, Natural, Enriched, Deficient, and Nonnatural through the public nested menu, verifies regenerated checked state, and persists exact final enum semantics. Multi-atom/mixed values, history, import/export, and scale remain explicit.

Passing production evidence traverses None, Singlet, Doublet, and Triplet through the public nested menu, verifies regenerated checked state, and persists exact final enum plus corrected CH2 Triplet-carbon semantics. Multi-atom/mixed values, atom-symbol interactions, history, import/export, and scale remain explicit.

Passing production evidence sets, hides, shows, edits, clears, and finally persists an Atom Number through the public dialog and menu. Its runtime annotation checks, inverse-command unchecked-state contract, physically targeted replace-existing text input, exact field-value completion, and independent exact atomNumber/showAtomNumber file oracle kill inverted visibility, stale clear, wrong-value, display-only, explicit-aria-false, untargeted-text, and actionable-only mutants. Retained runs exposed and fixed both the unchecked ARIA oracle and a text action that did not prove characters reached its declared input. Mixed selections, cancel input, custom annotation position, history, import/export, and scale remain explicit.

The registered production cell traverses Calculated/unset, R, S, r, s, and custom atom stereo descriptors through the public Atom Properties menu, verifies regenerated checked states and exact annotations, cancels an edited custom value without adding history, proves undo/redo, hides and shows the annotation, and persists exact cipStereo/showAtomStereo semantics. Mixed selections, stereochemical calculation, enhanced stereo, custom annotation position, import/export, and scale remain explicit.

The registered production cell covers both public values in the atom menu: Automatic and Hide. It verifies checked state, exact NH2/N rendering, one-step undo and redo, and an explicit persisted zero-hydrogen override. Other elements, mixed selections, label editing interactions, formats, and scale remain explicit.

Current evidence covers all eight public attached symbol kinds: circled positive/negative, uncircled plus/minus, radical-cation, radical-anion, single electron, and lone pair. Exact formal charge, implicit hydrogen, radical count, labels, symbol deltas, durable atom identity, and auto-link provenance are independently persisted. Label-glyph targeting, reassignment by dragging, history, formats, and scale remain explicit.

Production evidence covers all six public planar ring sizes, both chair conformers, benzene, exact six-membered ring fusion onto an existing bond, endpoint attachment, and single-bond continuation from a ring vertex through guarded real input with persisted topology and aromatic-order checks. History, properties, other formats, and scale remain explicit.

The registered production cells drag the public Chain tool across DPI-stable relative distances, require exact committed-bond counts, save through the native dialog, and independently distinguish a standalone five-node zigzag from a second four-bond chain attached at the existing endpoint. Other lengths, both zigzag phases, snapping variants, ring attachment, undo/redo, properties, formats, viewport sizes, and scale remain explicit.

Every actinide, all nine period-seven transition values Rf through Cn, and explicit standalone Carbon now have passing independent evidence. Together with existing Nitrogen and Oxygen palette attachment evidence, all 118 public periodic selectors are covered.
